notes.title: 2 Million Score Achievement | Plus "Fixes"
notes.content:
1. Made a "fix" for achievements not working past 500k for some players
2. Added a 2 million score achievement
3. Make sure to score OVER the achievement score to unlock it (example to unlock 500k you must score 500,100 points).

notes.title: New Post Processing Effects | New Achievement
notes.content:
New Post Processing Effects | New Achievement
1. New camera effects are now available
2. use "V" key to toggle them off/on in any level
3. Achievement added for toggling the effects off/on with "V" key
